title: Metric Ingestion Batch
description: A batch of metric points submitted for ingestion.

points.description: Metric points included in this ingestion batch.

metricId.description: The UUID of the metric definition. A metric that does not exist for the sending tenant rejects only this point.

ts.description: The metric timestamp in RFC 3339 date-time format, with an explicit offset. Stored with microsecond precision; a timestamp outside the range provisioned for storage rejects only this point.

value.description: The finite numeric value recorded for the metric, with an absolute value of at most 1e100. JSON has no NaN or Infinity; a larger magnitude or a number beyond the IEEE 754 double range rejects only this point (so the bound is enforced per point by the server, not by a schema keyword that would reject the whole batch).

source.description: The optional source identifier for this batch.
